surfaces.note: UNEXPLAINED DEBT, labelled rather than justified. Whoever next touches this surface should diagnose it and either fix it or replace this note with a real reason — do not read it as a justified exception.

Tempdoc 859 live-leg — the FIRST Search v3 surface in this register. Until now `ui-a11y-gate` covered no sv3 step at all, so the window the product is being rebuilt around had zero axe coverage in the deterministic state; the independent measured audit that found it also ran axe against this capture and got 0 violations, which is why the row lands with an EMPTY knownRules list rather than accepted debt. `sv3-composer-occlusion` is the step to register because it is the only sv3 capture deterministic enough for the proportion register too (1280x800, `sv3-sources` fixtures variant, Sources disclosure open, scrolled to max), so both gates read the same rendered state.
